description:
*“I'm really good at being obedient!”*

Yun Seo-Woo, the illegitimate daughter of Congressman Yun Jae-Jun, grew up forced into demure behavior. Raised like a wild animal in an orphanage, she enters a wealthy household to start a new life. Seo-Woo appears quiet on the surface, but hides a perverted, deviant nature within. Kim Eon-Hyeok, the grandson of WM Group, is a control freak who can't manage his emotions. He tries to manipulate Seo-Woo like a perfect wax figure, but it proves difficult. Her obedient attitude and quirky behavior gradually shake his resolve. The two, clashing with their different personalities and approaches, slowly grow closer. Kim Eon-Hyeok realizes he was ‘nothing more than that’ to Yeo-Ju and begs her. Seo-Woo breaks free from his control and accepts love on her own terms. Thus, the two continue their strange yet sweet married life.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
